subject: Auriga Retail Group — RFP-2026-118 / TECH: supplier portal access
body:
Hi Robert,

I hope all is well with you. We're making progress on our RFP-2026-118 for Security Awareness Training and we have a specific requirement related to ISO 27001 compliance that we need clarification on. Could you kindly share how your solution fits this standard?

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
Stefanie Auer

Auriga Retail Group
